matchups.tips: | Rush IBG. When he ults, kill his spirit and kite away using ranged w.
| Unplayable if she's good. Try to land some E's when her w is down.
| A lot of minions, terrible matchup. Maiden is very hard to kill, but without her he's weak. If he cages you, use ranged w to leap out of it.
| Can depend. If you can use your unstoppable ult when he ults, you won the 1v1. If not he makes every tentacle your ult spawns outside of the death realm disappear.
| Pre 6 he can win. Post 6 if you fight between 2 tentacles with R you win in an all in.
| Tank with a huge hitbox. Just don't fight him too low because of execute.
| Skill matchup. Watch out for executes when you're low, fight from a distance. if he ghosts on you wait for him to get close and land an e than ult his grab.
| Keep the lane shoved and keep harassing him under tower.
| Play around her w. If you can bait it you can land E's easily. She can regen a lot of health during her r. When she ults you hug a wall if you can so she can't proc all 4 vitals.
| Level 1-2 he can harass pretty hard with Q. You can destroy kegs the moment their health drops with leaped W. Keep him under tower.
| Very annoying champ. No mana, regenerates health just for existing and execute on ult. Keep harassing him and look for an all in under his tower when he is ~50% health.
| Buy doran's shield and don't lose too much health to mini gnar. You can look to kill mega gnar. Cancel his R shove with your R
| Your all in's better. You can land easy E by backing off near a low health minion and throwing your E at it when you think she will dash into it.
| You can damage his spirit during counterstrike with spells. Very free lane, you all in's better.
| Annoying champ. Very strong poke so hide behind minions. He can push you when you all in him so watch out for that.
| Tank, with predictable movement. Free E's
| Respect her early game with lethal tempo. Post 6 you can't kill her. Ask for ganks if her ult's down. Voltaic Cyclosword works well against her in the early and can allow you to snowball.
| Skill matchup. You can land an e easily when he ults onto you as he moves in a straight line.
| Very tanky but you can spam him easily under tower. Respect his suprising damage and make sure he loses cs.
| Harass him under tower and starve him of stacks and cs.
| Her late game damage is insane. Dodge ranged W and when she jumps on the wall just e straight at her when she jumps. Free E = Free trade.
| Harass him under tower. If he throws a Q you can stand near it and E. When he dashes to it, use R to become unstoppable and wipe the floor with him.
| Harass under tower. Stop damaging the spirit when his shield is pointing towards it and resume when it stops.
| Very hard lane. Go Fleet + doran's shield and just farm. if you land a kill you're golden. Consider going voltaic.
| Just be careful levels 1-3 and you're done. We counter him very easily as he has to get close to the minions to farm. Harass him under tower.
| Early game she beats us. Post 6 we destroy her. Her Q's are very predictable (especially the 3rd one).
| His huge hitbox makes it a bit easier to land E's, but still a very hard lane. Doran's shield + fleet. Don't stand in his ult and stand behind minions for his E
| If you can cancel his grab (R) with your ult, the all in is free.
| Very enjoyable lane. Your r does nothing on him so he only has 3 abilities.
| Just don't stand between him and his sword. Very easy lane.
| He will probably proxy all lane. Nothing you can do about it really. Farm the wave and go damage him and repeat. Ask for ganks. Be mindful with your ult as he can simply run away fast.
| He stands still half the time and has the hitbox of a small car. Easy lane.

| Stand behind minions for his Q. When you're pushing the wave be careful as he might ult you and spit you in his tower. Clear the waves asap and wait for your wave to get into his tower before getting near it.

| Very annoying creature. Ranged toplaners moment. Fleet + Doran's shield and survive. If you get voltaic you can all in him. If you land a close ranged W while you're blinded it won't make the tentacle hit him. Ranged ones will.
| Do not let him kill you pre 6 or the lane's over. Poke him down and look for an all in between 2 tentacles. If you don't miss your E you should win this and use that gold to win lane.
